port.name: JSON / JavaScript
port.description: Living Code for JSON / JavaScript. Repository-owned theme files, installation instructions and four color flavors.

guide.configuration: See [JSON / JavaScript's documentation](https://github.com/living-code-theme/palette) for application settings and reload behavior. The activation instructions above identify each supported flavor; keep your other application configuration.
guide.compatibility: Preserves the npm package name `@living-code/palette` and its existing import paths. Package publication and registry credentials are separate from creating this repository.
